definition: Sanctified food or offering distributed to devotees after being offered to a deity.
Selfless service performed on behalf of a temple or deity, often by volunteers or paid staff.
The charitable donation of food, especially cooked meals served free at temples.
A Hindu ritual of worship involving the circulation of light before a deity, typically performed at fixed times of day.
The auspicious viewing of a deity's murti (form) by a devotee.
The Hindu almanac used to determine auspicious dates and times for rituals.
A consecrated image or sculpted form of a deity used in worship.
A large-scale prasad offering, typically distributed on festival days or after major rituals.
A ritual bathing of the deity's murti with substances such as milk, honey, ghee, or water.
A Vedic fire ritual involving offerings into a consecrated fire.
